notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.content:
[b]Update V3.0[/b]
[h3][b]What’s New?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Map "Basin"
[*] New Map "Crystalized"
[*] New Map "Gold Field"
[*] New Map "Hilltop"
[*] New Map "Ruin Valley"
[/list]
[h3][b]Balancing[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered special gamemode chance to 15% instead of 30%
[/list]
[h3][b]Private match Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a "Map Rotates" Option
[*] Changed spawn rate of Landmines to a percent
[*] Changed spawn rate of Bear Traps to a percent
[/list]
[h3][b]Main Menu Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Background
[/list]
[h3][b]Map Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed spawns on Redwoods near Stonehenge
[/list]
[h3][b]Performance Updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased frame rate by lowering foliage
[*] Increased frame rate during night
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Reset List" to reset all settings in Private match settings
[*] Fixed Mushroom Regrow bug
[*] Fixed issue where spectators would get stuck underwater
[*] Fixed an issue related to a Hidden Achievement if you're not the host
[*] Fixed issue where deer bodies would occasionally break bear traps
[*] Fixed bug where bushes wouldn't render in
[*] Fixed issue where some UI would stay until following round
[/list]
[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed spawns on Redwoods near Stonehenge
[*] Updated collisions on rocks, fences, and trees to improve hit registration
[/list]

notes.title: Update V2.0
notes.content:
[b]Update V2.0[/b]
[h3][b]What’s New?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new map called “Plateau”
[*] Added new Landmine Gamemode (This mode has a low chance of activating each round)
[*] Added new Beartrap Gamemode (This mode has a low chance of activating each round)
[*] Added new settings for map rotation in private settings
[*] Added settings for new gamemodes to private game settings
[*] A new hidden achievement
[*] A new landmine achievement
[*] A new bear trap achievement
[/list]
[h3][b]Balancing[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Slowed default hunger speed
[*] Increased default munching buff
[*] Updated Max Walk Range for AI Deer to 800 from 400
[*] Changed AI munch rate
[*] Updated AI pathfinding
[*] Added timer for night sequence to prevent Wendigo from blocking the cabin and stopping the game loop
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed synchronization issue
[*] Fixed night time issue where spectators could get frozen
[*] Fixed issue that allowed the game to continue with no hunter/deer
[*] Fixed Issue where spectators could phase through the map
[*] Fixed Issue where more than 5 players could join one game
[*] Fixed issue where the host would crash when all players left the game
[/list]
[h3][b]Music & SFX’s[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered Main Menu Music
[/list]
[h3][b]UI Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed Hunter Release UI timer to 12 instead of 15
[/list]
[h3][b]Performance Updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased performance of shadows
[*] Optimized win conditions
[*] Changed scene spawning to waves instead of a single instance. (This should help prevent crashes on lower-end PCs)
[/list]

notes.title: Graphics Hot Fix March 16th
notes.content:
Added a safe mode option for anyone having issues with our game turning your computer into a Nasa space shuttle preparing for takeoff. 10. 9. 8...

(When the game launches for the first time feel free to click the safe mode option which will start the game with minimal graphic settings)

notes.title: Content Creator Playtest Patch Notes March 12th
notes.content:
[b]General Patch Notes[/b]

-Fixed issue where Ai deer speed wasnt being affected by private game settings

-Added new game setting to allow toggle talk. (Holding down the talking key was very annoying)

-Fixed issue where hosts movement speed wasn't being affected by private game settings after first round

-Fixed issue where hunter could lean into the cabin to survive through a wall

-Fixed collision on cabins

[b]Updated Nightime Loop[/b]

-Cabin Forces Player out at start and door shuts

-Once hunter looses sanity he has to return to the furthest cabin away from him
